ask: A page on each chapter that draws diagrams like the sponsor's five solution architecture documents; smart arrangement (radial, tree, orthogonal …); toggles between a chapter's views; model layers that strip a diagram.

sourceChangedSince.note: The package is built from the regression commit.

ranInNote: A clean git worktree of the regression commit, so the run tests exactly the committed code and not the working tree, which holds an untracked copy of the v20.5 package extracted into the source folder (it duplicates files that test:sol-evaluation counts). The worktree is removed afterwards.
stallNote: The two suites ran side by side and both stopped responding for the regression runner’s whole 25-minute limit while every other browser suite took 40–110 s; run alone on the same commit in the same worktree they pass in 43 s and 84 s. Recorded as a transient stall of the machine, not a failure of the code.
